system.notes: The Titanoi do not merely tread the base earth like common creatures, and why should their favored servants? With this sorcerous effect, a Zoran is capable of striding upon the winds as if they were solid ground. The sorcerer can only walk at a stately pace as he moves above the common earth as running is unbecoming to a master of men.
